# BOKU WMEE Application Templates

Anonymized templates for the Master in **Water Management and Environmental Engineering** at BOKU Vienna.

**No personal identifiers are included.** Replace placeholders before use.

## Placeholders

| Placeholder | Example |
|---|---|
| `[YOUR FULL NAME]` | Your legal name |
| `[YOUR PHONE]` | +234 XXX XXX XXXX |
| `[YOUR EMAIL]` | you@email.com |
| `[YOUR LINKEDIN]` | Optional |
| `[DATE]` | Application date |
| `[CITY, COUNTRY]` | Ibadan, Nigeria |

## Files

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `01-cv-boku-focused.md` | Full CV |
| `02-ects-mapping-ui-to-boku-wmee.md` | UI → BOKU ECTS mapping |
| `03-motivation-letter-boku-wmee.md` | Motivation letter |
| `05-professor-outreach-emails.md` | Email templates |
| `06-one-page-cv-for-email.html` | 1-page CV — open in browser → Print → Save as PDF |

## Phone: save as PDF

1. Open any `.html` file in **Chrome**
2. Tap **⋮** → **Share** → **Print** → **Save as PDF**
